name: lightrag
description: Wraps HKUDS's LightRAG (HKUDS/LightRAG, family C, BASELINE_METRIC_PLAN.md §4): LLM-driven entity/relationship extraction into a knowledge graph, answered via a configurable retrieval mode (local/global/hybrid/naive/mix -- default "mix", combining graph traversal with vector retrieval over text chunks). Comparison point alongside mem0/langmem/a_mem/memoryos/zep/hipporag/hypermem/graphrag for whether a graph-RAG framework beats plain RAG (bm25_rag/dense_rag) or a rolling summary (running_summary); the most direct comparison is against `graphrag`, since both build an LLM-extracted knowledge graph, but LightRAG's own vector+graph "mix" retrieval never builds GraphRAG's community-report hierarchy.
author: Wnsdnl
